system.description:
You were in the business of healing, as a doctor or nurse or maybe even a veterinarian. Given your medical background, you have a lot of experience with treating injuries and diseases.

Qualities

Assign one of d10, d8, or d6 to @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.9HxtjpcxtAZ5pS2M]{Medicine} and the other two dice to two of the following qualities:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.N7c8j5IUBEVL7y9h]{Finesse}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.yfrz6TSCgB2EzH4E]{Science}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.qualities.Item.8sdeTQgqsZuFExgc]{Technology}

• Select from Mental qualities category

Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

Power Source

Roll d10, d8, d8 for power source selection.
